images.alt: Funerary relief of the so called "rich style". It is a representation of a dexiosis ("reception"). The deceased seated to the left holds a bird in her left hand while greeting a standing woman. 5th-c. BCE. Aegina archaeological museum, inv. 2222. Aegina, Greece.
